row.name: Flutter-Movie-App-with-Clean-Architecture-and-RiverPod-State-Management
row.description: FilmKu is an open-source Flutter movie application that exemplifies clean architecture principles while leveraging the power of both Riverpod and Bloc for state management. The app utilizes the Movies Database API to provide users with an immersive movie discovery experience. With dependency injection powered by get_it.
